Undelete brings the same version back with a new tag and equal digest; capacity from the kept byte count before any effect (product code, real stores).

Restore writes an older version as a new one with cas = current, also over a deleted current; deleted or trimmed sources are 409; the source value appears in no database row (product code, real stores).

Concurrency with uncertain outcomes: the stale-work sweep moves executing operations to uncertain and accepted ones to rejected, one audit row each under two sweepers; a swept executor can neither finalize nor dispatch; the slot blocks the environment until settled (product code, real stores).

Unknown result: a landed write is reconciled as success without exclusion; a not-landed write is rejected only after executor exclusion; deletes and undeletes always need exclusion; evidence conflicts can be closed as unknown (product code, real stores; staging drill).
